title: Royale Equestrian Centre
specs: Indoor arena 72' x 182' with fibre footing
Second indoor arena with 9 box stalls and heated tack/viewing lounge
3 outdoor sand rings including dressage and show jumping rings
5+ acre cross country jump field with variety of fences

Group sessions available for educational, team building, scouts, guides, group homes, home schooling, and more; custom packages available

blurb: Guests take horseback riding lessons ranging from trial lessons to full programs for all ages and levels. The centre offers private, semi-private, and group lessons, as well as horse boarding with full care and educational opportunities. Facilities include indoor arenas, outdoor rings, cross country jump fields, and a party room.
extraNote: No refunds once lesson is booked · No make up lessons for absences; one free educational session per month included; additional educational sessions may be booked
